description: Typed TypeScript and Python clients, a CLI, and a local MCP server for Ausca pay-per-call agent infrastructure.
rules: Use the ausca package as the default TypeScript front door and @ausca/sdk only for the library-only engine.
Keep payment behind PaymentAuthority and enforce an explicit per-call cap before signing.
Commit document and media bytes through the keyless artifact ingress before invoking an artifact-backed offer.
Reuse the same idempotency key for an uncertain retry; never create a second purchase to discover the first outcome.
Use examples/journeys.mjs for browser, inbox, document, and transcription lifecycle composition without adding another client abstraction.
